title: cerastium jiuhuashanense
intro: Cerastium jiuhuashanense, commonly known as Jiuhua Snow-in-Summer, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting healing, making it beneficial for treating wounds and skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium jiuhuashanense include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe and calm irritated skin. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
